Select optimal k for PAM clustering using silhouette width

Source: R/find_kpam.R
find_kpam.Rd

Evaluates a range of cluster numbers (k) for Partitioning Around Medoids (PAM) clustering based on average silhouette width and returns the optimal number of clusters.

Usage

find_kpam(pd.dis)

Arguments

pd.dis

A dissimilarity object of class dist. This must represent a valid pairwise distance matrix.

Value

A list with:

best_k

Integer. The number of clusters that maximizes the average silhouette width.

sil_val

Data frame with columns: K (evaluated cluster numbers) and avg_sil (mean silhouette width for each k).

Details

The function evaluates cluster numbers in the range 2:15 (default fixed range) using pam with diss = TRUE. For each k, the mean silhouette width across clusters is computed.

The optimal k is selected as the value that maximizes the average silhouette width.

See also

pam, silhouette

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# pd.dis must be a 'dist' object
res <- find_kpam(pd.dis)
res$best_k
plot(res$sil_val$K, res$sil_val$avg_sil, type = "b")
} # }
